subject.title: feat(reef): follow up on unconfirmed deliveries instead of staying silent

question: Should Reef treat an unconfirmed receipt after roughly ten minutes as an owner-facing agent event, accepting the documented small race where a subsequent receipt can leave the delay notice uncorrected?
rationale: This PR introduces a durable, user-visible notification policy rather than repairing an established silent-failure contract; tests can validate mechanics but cannot determine the desired alerting and tradeoff policy.

options.title: Adopt the delayed-notice contract
options.body: Accept the ten-minute owner notification and documented receipt race after reviewing live behavior proof and exact-head checks.

options.title: Require stronger delivery-state guarantees
options.body: Pause the feature and design a durable notice-outbox or acknowledgement model if every delay notice must receive a definitive closing outcome.

options.title: Keep the current quiet behavior
options.body: Decline the new owner-notification policy and retain receipt handling without overdue follow-up events.

recommendation.title: Adopt the delayed-notice contract
recommendation.body: Accept the ten-minute owner notification and documented receipt race after reviewing live behavior proof and exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Reef lifecycle work and this proposal make this person the clearest available routing candidate for the delivery-policy decision.
